Create one polished 4:3 Video Lookbook Sheet for Imperial Wound as a single finished visual-language guide for downstream film and video generation. Do not make a collage of existing images.

## Header and palette
Header: Imperial Wound. Thesis: history becoming machinery. Add named swatches for dim imperial gold #C7B06A, Bosporus winter gray #66727A, cinnabar command red #4A1E1B, worked bronze #8A6437, tent canvas and parchment #D8C8A7, powder black #171B1B, and fresh wound red #A33A2E.

## Cinematic examples
Show four panels: a Byzantine council room with cold gray daylight and insufficient amber candles; an Ottoman command tent with disciplined red, cream, black, bronze, and deliberate lamp placement; a cannon foundry close study with bronze, soot, molten furnace glow, hands, tools, and smoke; a Theodosian wall or siege dawn with tiny figures, cracked stone, smoke-reduced light, and mechanical consequence.

## Rule cards
Add compact cards for composition, lighting, texture and materials, and camera. Use only short captions: power is frontal and symmetrical; labor breaks order with ropes, smoke, bodies; cold daylight drains Byzantine rooms; furnace glow turns craft into judgment; bronze, soot, parchment, wet rope, cracked stone; slow history, sudden physics.

## Finish
Clean editorial production-board style, readable large labels, no paragraphs, fake UI, marketing-poster treatment, or modern anachronisms.
